text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — P1: kv-cache miss storm + increased latency for hosted inference in us-west-2. Affected route: /v1/generate (models/*/redwood-alpha). Error rate spike ~12% over baseline. Paging: @Lee (oncall) @Jamie (eng-runtime). Runbook: https://redwood/ops/runbooks/kv-cache-incident :rotating_light:

Lee (oncall): taking it. I see the spike on the dashboard. Starting mitigation: throttling suspect model at edge and enabling fallback route.

Jamie (eng-runtime): joining. Thanks. Quick hypothesis: recent quantization bump + new batching heuristic causing KV cache churn and long-tail latency. Can we fallback traffic to quantized-v1-safe?

Nora (sre): scaling dedicated pool +2 GPUs for affected capacity. Adding extra rollout watchers.

Sam (customer-success): FYI — initial CS triage: ~420 customers experienced elevated latency (5-20s). 3 customers reported timeouts and we opened support tickets: acct-8342, acct-9921, acct-1100. CS has temporary status page blurb ready.

Lee (oncall): mitigation actions executed:
- edge routing rule: route redwood-alpha -> redwood-alpha-safe @ 25%
- disabled prefix KV caching for redwood-alpha in prod
- applied model-level throttle (50 rps -> 15 rps)
After changes, error rate decreased to ~1.8% and tail latency trending down. :white_check_mark:

Jamie (eng-runtime): good signal. I'm grabbing logs and traces now. snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-16T14:02:11Z] kv_cache: miss_rate=0.48 latency_ms=1250 model=redwood-alpha quant=v2
[2026-03-16T14:02:12Z] batching: join_size=12 queued=310
```
Looks like miss storm coincided with aggressive auto-join batching.

Yana (eng-ml): I will run the quant regression harness against the canary build. Suspect per-layer scale mismatch after the quant patch; will attempt reproducer with representative prompts.

Lee (oncall): scheduling post-incident review. Proposed: 2026-03-23 10:00 PT (30m). Invite: eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-sre, customer-success, product if needed. Please accept or propose alternates.

Action items (initial):
- A1: Add per-variant KV miss instrumentation & per-route counters. Owner: Jamie. Due: 2026-03-18.
- A2: Revert/rollback quantization patch in canary and run full regression suite. Owner: Yana. Due: 2026-03-20.
- A3: Implement route-level circuit breaker to limit cascade on KV miss storms. Owner: Nora. Due: 2026-03-22.
- A4: Run synthetic load tests validating batching heuristics with KV disabled to recreate behavior and tune join thresholds. Owner: Lee. Due: 2026-03-19.
- A5: CS follow-up with impacted customers + propose credit/mitigation plan. Owner: Sam. Due: 2026-03-17.

Jamie (eng-runtime): temp edge command used to route traffic (for audit):
```
curl -X POST https://edge-api.internal/routing \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \n  -d '{"route":"redwood-alpha","target":"redwood-alpha-safe","weight":0.25}'
```

Lee (oncall): I also disabled prefix cache with the feature flag: `kv.prefix_cache.enabled=false` for that variant. Will re-enable only after regression sign-off.

Sam (customer-success): CS will send templated outreach to affected customers and track follow-ups in Zendesk. I'll post a summary after first outreach.

Yana (eng-ml): preliminary reproducer steps (added to the incident doc): 1) load prompt corpus from production sampler 2) apply quant-v2 weights 3) run with join_size=12 and KV warmup disabled. If I can reproduce, I'll add unit tests and a perf scenario.

Nora (sre): will draft implementation plan for circuit breaker and brief on-call runbook updates.

Lee (oncall): next check-in EOD or earlier if signal regresses. Postmortem draft owner: Jamie (eng-runtime). Please add notes to the incident doc: https://redwood/incidents/4023456789-kv-miss-storm

incident-bot: Pager resolved by Lee (oncall). Incident status: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Pager closed. :white_check_mark:

Lee (oncall): thanks team — important to get instrumentation and the canary revert in ASAP. Will update the postmortem thread once the write-up is ready.

Jamie (eng-runtime): I'll take A1 and draft the postmortem skeleton today.

Yana (eng-ml): taking A2, will push test results to the incident doc by 2026-03-20.

Sam (customer-success): A5 noted, outreach scheduled for 2026-03-17 morning.

Nora (sre): starting on A3 design doc, ETA 2026-03-22.

Lee (oncall): closing out live thread. If anything regresses ping me directly. :pray:
